description: Application for a Minor Material Amendment (S73a) to vary conditions 2 (approved drawings), 4 (protection of existing trees and hedgerows) and 7 (scheme of tree planting and pits)of planning permission ref: 223366FUL dated 15/02/2023 for: Conversion of existing building from 6no. flats into 9no. self-contained residential units; single storey, part 2 storey and part 3 storey, side/rear/side (wraparound) extension; creation of balconies and roof terraces to rear elevation; rear roof extension including increase in ridge height; alterations to fenestration; installation of front boundary wall; and provision of associated amenity space, car parking, refuse and cycle storage. Amendment seeks to revise application site boundary and reduction in the size of the approved communal garden
